row.evidence: Podio's pricing table and docs never mention SCIM; its SSO configuration supports only two identity providers, Google (G Suite or Workspace) and Microsoft (Office 365), and members are removed by hand in the User Management tool.
row.notes: No SCIM by absence: the pricing page, the full Podio documentation sitemap (459 pages on progress.com), the API reference and Okta's catalogue (SWA app only) show no SCIM or SAML. Podio's 'SSO configuration' on upgraded accounts enforces Google or Microsoft (Office 365) sign-in per domain; that is social-style sign-in, not SAML with the customer's own IdP, so sso_plan is null. Podio is now sold by Progress; organisations managed via ShareFile add and remove users there. The Podio API (OAuth 2) on every plan, including Free, can list and search org members, end org membership and manage space memberships, but cannot create organisation users.

google.notes: Podio can enforce Google (G Suite or Workspace) sign-in per domain; no provisioning documented.

open_questions: Whether Podio's Custom plans offer SAML SSO or SCIM; nothing public says so.
Whether removing an employee frees the seat automatically; the docs tell admins to update the licence count in billing by hand.
Whether an audit-log API or user-event webhooks exist.
